blocks.text: The reigning Miss Universe national titleholders from Sweden, Pakistan and Egypt all flew to Manila ahead of their international competition slated next month in Puerto Rico. Filipino publicist, publisher and entrepreneur Josh Yugen, who is the national director and official Miss Universe franchise holder for the three countries, brought his queens to the Philippines to prepare for the international competition. Miss Universe Sweden Josefin Strand, Miss Universe Pakistan Misbah Arshad and Miss Universe Egypt Sonia Gergis have gone under the guidance of some of the country’s most respected pageant mentors and coaches. “Since 2022, we have consistently brought our queens to […]...
